description: This file defines the VarDefHandler class, which manages variable definitions and options for modules in SuiteCRM, including methods to retrieve and filter vardef arrays, handle relationships, and compare attribute types.

classes.name: VarDefHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling variable definitions for modules, including retrieving vardef arrays and filtering fields based on types and relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the VarDefHandler with a module object and optional meta array name.

methods.name: get_vardef_array
methods.description: Retrieves and filters the vardef array for a module, returning options for fields based on type or other criteria.

methods.name: compare_type
methods.description: Compares a field's properties against target meta array criteria to include or exclude it.
